text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Transitional National Council adopts state budget for 1997. Budget envisages receipts of 829.4 billion dinars against spending of 914.1 billion dinars. Taxes on gas and oil sectors provide more than half receipts at 451 billion dinars.
- Car bomb kills three and wounds 20 in Algiers.
- Three people died and 100 were wounded in car bomb explosion in central Algiers.
- Car bomb kills eight and wounds scores in downtown Algiers at rush hour on Monday.
- Car that exploded on Monday in central Algiers was stolen in Eucalyptus district south of capital.
